arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import glom.core as core
import glom.reduction as red
import glom.mutation as mut
import glom.streaming as stream

classes = [
    ('Coalesce', core.Coalesce),
    ('Inspect', core.Inspect),
    ('Call', core.Call),
    ('Invoke', core.Invoke),
    ('Check', core.Check),
    ('Auto', core.Auto),
    ('Fill', core.Fill),
    ('Fold', red.Fold),
    ('Merge', red.Merge),
    ('Assign', mut.Assign),
    ('Iter', stream.Iter),
]

for name, cls in classes:
    has_repr = hasattr(cls, '__repr__') and cls.__repr__ is not object.__repr__
    print(f'{name}: has __repr__ = {has_repr}')
"
